headline: Restaurant Online publishes a feature on the UK sushi market, putting YO! at around 500 locations and itsu at about 80 restaurants.
body: The trade feature describes a fast-growing market in which established chains, both founded in London in 1997, now compete with handroll bars and poké specialists. YO!'s count includes supermarket concessions, and many operators have added poké, bento, ramen and hot noodles to reach more eating occasions.
why: It is a current snapshot of how far the British-founded sushi chains have scaled and how the category is splitting into new formats (lessons 4, 5 and 7).
